comment: Default-FAIL verification contract for T-001 (high, tdd). Required set per risk-gate-matrix.md tier high. Created at gate time by the 2026-08-17 quality-gate run (Run ID a4-t001-qg-2026-08-17); every check started at passes=false and was flipped only after the named command ran in this gate session and its output was saved to specs/epic-192-a4-facet-manifest/verification/T-001/gate-20260817-checks.log. Gate cycle 1 applied one safe fix per auto-fix-policy (comment-only docstring rewording in validate-facet-manifest.py to clear a check-placeholders case-insensitive-pattern false positive on the phrase 'not implemented'); both focused suites re-ran green after the fix and the placeholder scan passed. Stack 'shell' waives lint/typecheck/build: this repository ships Python, shell, PowerShell and JS deliverables with no compile toolchain, no configured linter and no static type-checker; parse validity is exercised by every green run of both runtimes of both suites. The check-component-coverage tier-minimum id is recorded present but not required: check-contract.py drops it from the high/critical minimum while sdd/project-context.yaml is absent (CAPABILITY_STATE_GATED_IDS) and that file does not exist in this repository, so the gate derives disabled-legacy and exits 0 unconditionally; a passes:true entry would be fabricated. TDD Red/Green: the RED log (red-sh.log) was captured by the Attempt-1 implementation run before the validator existed in final form; the GREEN evidence is both the Attempt-1 green-sh.log and this gate's own independent re-execution recorded in gate-20260817-checks.log (bash 43/0 + 13/0, pwsh 43/0 + 13/0, exit 0 each). TEST-002's YAML round-trip runs through the real canonicalize-sdd-yaml subprocess, present in this tree since the 0ae1ef49 origin/main merge.

No static type-check command is configured for this repository's Python/shell/PowerShell/JS deliverables (stack: shell).

No network or service integration surface. This task's deliverables are a JSON Schema contract file, local CLI validator scripts and their shell/PowerShell twins, test suites and fixture trees, all operating only on local repository files. The one subprocess boundary (canonicalize-sdd-yaml) is exercised end-to-end by TEST-002's YAML round-trip inside the acceptance suite.

Tier-minimum id gated off by check-contract.py's CAPABILITY_STATE_GATED_IDS: sdd/project-context.yaml does not exist in this repository, so check-component-coverage derives disabled-legacy, evaluates zero Fail conditions and exits 0 unconditionally (run and recorded in gate-20260817-checks.log). Requiring a passes:true entry for a structurally inert gate would be a fabricated pass, so the id is recorded present and not required, per the predicate's own documented rationale.
